description: This file defines a class 'XmlWriter' that provides utility methods for programmatically generating XML documents with proper indentation, attribute handling, and escaping special characters.

classes.name: XmlWriter
classes.description: A utility class for writing XML documents with support for indentation, attributes, and escaping special characters.

methods.name: XmlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes XmlWriter with an existing Writer, setting ownership, indentation offset, and whether to add an XML prefix.

methods.name: writeEntity
methods.description: Begins a new XML element with the specified name.

methods.name: closeOpeningTag
methods.description: Closes the start tag of an XML element, writing out attributes and indentation.

methods.name: writeAttributes
methods.description: Writes all accumulated attributes for the current element.

methods.name: writeAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the current XML element, escaping special characters in the value.

methods.name: endEntity
methods.description: Closes the current XML element, writing the end tag or self-closing tag if empty.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the XmlWriter, flushing and closing the underlying writer if owned.

methods.name: writeText
methods.description: Writes text content inside an XML element, escaping special characters.

methods.name: escapeXml
methods.description: Static method to escape special XML characters in a string.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Static method to replace occurrences of a substring within a string, with a limit on replacements.
